summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, reporting the declaration of quarterly cash dividends on its 8.00% Series C and Series D Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Shares. The dividend is $0.50 per share for each series, payable July 30, 2026, to holders of record July 17, 2026. This is a routine dividend announcement, not a special situation. No transaction, merger, restructuring, or activist campaign is involved.
